capabilities: Draw pressure-sensitive ink with multiple nibs, eraser, shapes, lasso and undo on an infinite canvas
Convert handwriting to typed text and recognise handwritten formulas into a calculator-style notation
Embed vault PDFs and videos from YouTube, TikTok and other providers as draggable, resizable frames
Organise boards into multi-page notebooks with tags, tasks, bookmarks and paper backgrounds
Merge boards across sync tools and recover conflict copies and old .onenote files
extras: Interface ships in English and Spanish. By default translation sends text to free public endpoints (Google, MyMemory) unless a local model mode is enabled; formula recognition and drawing run entirely offline via a bundled 450 KB neural network. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Older .onenote files are migrated automatically.
intentEvidence: It is modelled on OneNote, which is what most people who study with a tablet are used to
motivation: The author built it modelled on OneNote, since that is what people who study with a tablet are used to, while keeping everything inside the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no OneNote-style freeform handwriting surface for taking notes with a stylus on a tablet, with ink, PDFs and video on one canvas inside the vault.
